target_region.coordinate_rule: main_0/1/2 inverse native-edge scaling via parse_fcd REAL_SPAN_M; not raw SUMO x/y or lane-pos

source_vehicle_rule: All predeclared vehicles satisfying prespecified region/time and formal P2; no favorable-ID selection; exact region/cohort not frozen

cohort_candidates.rule: Before treatment, include every declared ID whose fixed route has main_0 or main_1 mainline support intersecting target, including eligible117 initial and1033 noninitial as route permits. Actual target-window observations determine measurement support, never ID eligibility.
cohort_candidates.exclusion_reason: Fixed input route contains neither main_0 nor main_1; cannot traverse proposed target; no outcome used
cohort_candidates.exclusions: No exclusions by P2/rho/outcome; entering route includes main_1 and exiting route includes main_0/main_1
cohort_candidates.missing_policy: Retain planned IDs; report native pending/undeparted/no-target-entry separately; D1 only qualified observed links, missing never zero

cohort_candidates.rule: Fixed IDs present in prespecified region at an actual pre180s clock, same across paired arms before either manipulation; exact clock/region awaits decision
cohort_candidates.limitation: Excludes later entrants and changes estimand; do not select after inspecting treatment P2 or rho

cohort_qualification: Follower and leader incarnations resolved, reliable following, native lane continuity, both-end .1s observation; no valid following -> unevaluable, not zero event

physical_path.actual_semantics: Forward road topology precheck; same-vehicle forward-time edges; contemporaneous leader -> follower edges. tau_p is absolute earliest visited target clock, not duration or message arrival.
limitations: Existing helper does not enforce max temporal gap or incarnation/leader quality; a returned path is not by itself a qualified scientific physical arrival
Forward traffic reachability precheck rejects downstream->upstream before leader influence traversal; this cannot establish that an upstream shock path is physically impossible
Internal-junction lane and native boundary leaders in A03 measured state are unresolved; no cross-edge leader imputation
No confirmed B00 P2 source exists in observed eligible context; event-specific tau_p is undefined, never filled with zero
physical_path.proposed_qualified_rule: Use archived incarnation-resolved, reliable both-end same-native-lane links at .1s (<=.11s), forward vehicle continuity only with verified lane connections; influence leader->follower at actual clock. Separate road reachability from influence reachability. No production change in R0.

statuses.finite_arrival: actual connected witness, earliest target clock >= chosen source onset/confirmation clock
statuses.uncertain_missing_links: identity present but unobserved/junction/gapped leader chain; not proof of unreachable
statuses.topology_disconnected: Only verified disconnection of specified directed graph, with graph type explicitly stated
statuses.right_censored: No observed target witness before observation end; incomplete graph remains uncertain

source_clock_candidates: onset_s for physical-source origin; confirmation_s for usable detected source; retain both and never call message time physical
